an7.6:1.3: saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ. (1)
an7.6:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti. saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an7.6:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe… buddho bhagavāti
an7.6:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmeraya majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an7.6:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirimā hoti. hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.6:5.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti. ottapati kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, ottapati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.6:6.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti, dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
an7.6:7.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
an7.6:8.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti …pe… sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
